description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Wish List' controller within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages operations such as displaying, adding, listing, and removing products from a user's wishlist, including handling AJAX requests and JSON responses.

classes.name: WishList
classes.description: Controller class for managing the user's wishlist, extending the base Controller class in OpenCart, providing methods for viewing, adding, listing, and removing wishlist items.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the wishlist page if user is logged in; otherwise, redirects to login page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the wishlist view with the current list of wishlisted products.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the JSON-encoded wishlist data for AJAX requests.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the wishlist, either for logged-in users or for guest sessions, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the wishlist for logged-in users or guest session, returning a JSON response indicating success or error.
